BAELL — Amazon PDP Image Wireframe

This wireframe maps out the seven gallery images for each BAELL product on Amazon: the Farro Glow Cream Ampoule, the Farro Soothing Ampoule and the Farro Soothing Cleansing Foam. Each set moves from the main image to benefits, ingredients and proof, so a shopper understands the product before reaching the A+ Content.

How to walk through it: pick a product, and scroll top to bottom the way a shopper would. Each card shows an example image, a short visual description of our version, and the copy for that image; for the two ampoules, most examples come from BAELL's own PDFs and only need a rebuild at 2,000 x 2,000, while the cleanser examples are third party layout references only. Red lines are required safety notes.
